race.description: Drive The Future With Byd Hcp (C4)
race.comment: ROGUERY (1) has been safely held in two runs since coming to the Gollan stable this prep, the latest a four-length defeat over 1600m at Doomben as favourite. Looking for this longer journey now and finds an easier race this evening. Can turn things around. OLD SONG (4) is going well including a close fourth in a BM68 over this course and distance four weeks ago. Has been in work for a while and continues to bring home cheques for connections. Solid each-way hope. CARDIOLOGIST (3) backs up six days after a plain effort over a shorter trip at Toowoomba. Draws a nice gate and is capable of a lot better. LORD PROTECTOR (9) has won just three from 37 so hard to get too excited about his prospects. Failed in open company last start but a return to a Class 4 should see him be competitive. HAZEY HILL (2) needed the hit-out last time out at Ipswich when fresh from a seven-week let-up. Expect a better run this evening.
